evidence.reason: The pre-scan catch in src/ops/sweep/taskLoop.ts now rethrows the original error when a stop was already observed, so cancellation keeps the 'enclosing job cancelled' reason and a missing scanner keeps its own message instead of being reported as a worker upload denylist refusal.
